baseline.timingStatus: Untimed user-supplied chord order. It cannot support whole-song duration-weighted chord accuracy or transition-time accuracy. No section boundaries or E/Esus4 durations are assumed.
baseline.comparisonPolicy: Only event-order edit counts against both structural variants. Ignore chord duration, merge consecutive identical canonical predictions, trim leading/trailing N only, retain internal N or X as explicit mismatch events. Report exact root/formula and root-only edit counts independently. Do not label an edit statistic as full-song chord accuracy.
baseline.metricWarning: These are unit-cost ordered event edit counts, not duration-weighted accuracy. Counts describe one optimal alignment; no best structural variant is selected. Root-only sequences additionally merge consecutive equal roots.

variants.name: printed-one-instrumental-cycle
variants.status: Exactly the supplied printed repetition count.

variants.name: two-instrumental-cycles-hypothesis
variants.status: The available audio appears to repeat this cycle twice; the supplied chart prints one. This is an unverified structural hypothesis and is reported separately, not selected to maximize a score.
